contract: Editorial policy is bound to the canonical series chapter-to-work scope, with optimistic enabled/severity/readiness overrides and revisioned custom model checks. Explicit judge, reader-panel and comparative-rank actions use only the configured reasoning adapter and pin source revisions. Anchored cut findings create immutable reviewed polishing candidates; apply and undo reuse canonical work promotion and revision restoration.
acceptance: Per-series policy persists effective enabled state, severity and transparent readiness gates; standalone works retain an explicit isolated scope and request/revision conflicts fail closed.

Custom checks support create, update and delete with bounded prompts and exact series scope; their configured-model findings use the same typed anchored runner and never accept routing or credential overrides.

Judge, panel and comparative ranking are explicit configured-provider actions with bounded typed outputs, exact candidate identities or manuscript quotes, immutable source revision provenance and truthful unavailable/stale states.
Reviewed cuts preview without changing the manuscript, apply only through an immutable polishing candidate, and undo through canonical WorkStore revision restoration without altering unrelated text.
Real HTTP, native tool and console controls exercise the same stores, close provider/model/home/runtime override shapes, and preserve original editorial catalog and repair behavior.
limits: A configured external reasoning model was unavailable in isolated local qualification, so successful judge, panel, rank and custom-check inference remains an external qualification gap.
Parent creative.12 remains incomplete until successful configured-model journeys and the complete multi-issue editorial acceptance are qualified; child source presence alone does not close it.
